summary: Deployments must now set a new DROP_JOB_TOKEN_SECRET variable; the drop service refuses to start without it.
details: DROP_JOB_TOKEN_SECRET signs and verifies drop's per-job scoped tokens. It is a separate secret from NORA_DROP_TOKEN (the master credential), and is documented in .env.example.
docker-compose.yml declares it as required, so an existing deployment that upgrades without adding it fails to bring drop up rather than starting in a degraded state.
